categories.main_business_segments: The company operates as a comprehensive provider of motor vehicle inspection solutions and automotive aftermarket services. Primary business segments include: (1) Motor vehicle inspection systems (safety, environmental, and comprehensive testing systems); (2) Industry networking and supervision systems for inspection agencies; (3) Driver examination and training systems; (4) Motor vehicle emission remote sensing monitoring systems; (5) Road overload enforcement solutions; and (6) Motor vehicle inspection operation and service business through acquired inspection stations across multiple provinces.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company develops and manufactures motor vehicle inspection equipment and systems using proprietary technologies including high-precision sensing, AI algorithm analysis, and cloud-based management platforms. Core manufacturing capabilities include self-designed and self-produced inspection test benches, control systems, and data acquisition front-ends. The company holds 90 patents, 209 software copyrights, and multiple non-patented technologies. Production follows a customized order-based model with in-house design and manufacturing of critical components, supplemented by outsourced procurement of standard components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include motor vehicle inspection agencies nationwide, automotive manufacturers, research institutions, repair enterprises, and government departments (traffic management, environmental protection, and public security). The company serves both mandatory inspection markets (safety, emissions, commercial vehicle testing) and non-mandatory markets (new vehicle certification, fault diagnosis, used vehicle assessment). End markets span the entire automotive aftermarket ecosystem.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates across all 31 provincial-level administrative regions in mainland China (excluding Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan). Major service networks include 32 service points covering Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest regions. Key operational presence in provinces including Shandong, Hubei, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan, Henan, and Anhui through acquired inspection stations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: upstream as a manufacturer and supplier of motor vehicle inspection systems and equipment to inspection agencies; midstream through system integration and installation services; and downstream through direct operation of motor vehicle inspection stations via acquisitions and new establishments. The company has vertically integrated from equipment manufacturing to inspection service operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Development of new energy vehicle inspection solutions aligned with GB/T44500-2024 standards; (2) Advancement of intelligent and digitalized inspection systems with AI and cloud computing; (3) Expansion of vehicle-road-cloud collaborative intelligent inspection technology; (4) Development of battery health assessment and dynamic battery management systems; (5) Construction of comprehensive smart inspection platforms; and (6) Exploration of battery swap and charging equipment manufacturing. R&D focuses on three technology tracks: new energy vehicle inspection, dynamic battery management, and intelligent networked vehicle detection.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple streams: (1) Product sales of motor vehicle inspection systems and equipment to inspection agencies and manufacturers; (2) System integration and installation services; (3) Maintenance and technical support services; (4) Inspection operation services through owned and operated inspection stations; (5) Value-added services including used vehicle transaction services, insurance agency services, and battery detection services; (6) Software licensing and system monitoring services. Revenue is recognized upon customer acceptance of products or completion of services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic provider of comprehensive motor vehicle inspection solutions and automotive aftermarket services. It is one of few companies capable of simultaneously providing complete motor vehicle inspection system solutions, intelligent driver examination systems, emission remote sensing solutions, and networked supervision systems. The company holds leadership positions in system equipment manufacturing and operates as one of the largest motor vehicle inspection service providers through its network of inspection stations. Competitive advantages include technological leadership, comprehensive solution capabilities, and integrated service ecosystem.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2024, the company reported total assets of 2.53 billion yuan and net assets attributable to shareholders of 1.79 billion yuan. 2024 operating revenue was 448.2 million yuan (down 3.05% year-over-year), with net loss of 212.9 million yuan (compared to 58.5 million yuan loss in 2023). The company experienced significant challenges in 2024 due to policy impacts on vehicle inspection frequency, resulting in goodwill impairment charges. Operating cash flow remained positive at 52.6 million yuan.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's value proposition centers on providing integrated, standardized, and intelligent motor vehicle inspection solutions that address the full lifecycle of inspection services. Key differentiators include: (1) Comprehensive solution capability covering equipment, systems, operations, and monitoring; (2) Advanced technology incorporating AI, cloud computing, and IoT; (3) Standardized service delivery through chain-operation model; (4) Digital management platforms enabling efficient operations; (5) Integrated aftermarket services ecosystem; and (6) Compliance with evolving national standards including new energy vehicle inspection requirements. The company emphasizes quality assurance, operational efficiency, and comprehensive service coverage as core competitive advantages.
